symptoms.name: Headache
symptoms.description: Pain or discomfort in the head, scalp, or neck area, ranging from mild to severe.

severity_descriptors.10: Worst headache of life — emergency warning

symptoms.name: Sudden Severe Headache (Thunderclap)
symptoms.description: An abrupt, extremely severe headache reaching maximum intensity within seconds to minutes — sometimes described as the worst headache of one's life.

symptoms.name: Dizziness
symptoms.description: A sensation of unsteadiness, lightheadedness, or a spinning feeling (vertigo) that may impair balance.

symptoms.name: Confusion / Altered Mental Status
symptoms.description: Sudden or gradual inability to think clearly, disorientation to time, place or person, or changes in alertness.

symptoms.name: Numbness or Tingling
symptoms.description: Abnormal sensations including numbness, tingling, or a 'pins and needles' feeling in any body part.

severity_descriptors.10: Complete loss of sensation — seek urgent evaluation

symptoms.name: Limb Weakness
symptoms.description: Reduced strength or ability to move one or more limbs, which may appear suddenly or develop gradually.

symptoms.name: Vision Changes
symptoms.description: Any change in vision including blurring, double vision, partial or total loss, or flashing lights.

symptoms.name: Facial Drooping
symptoms.description: Sudden weakness or drooping on one side of the face — a key warning sign of possible stroke.

symptoms.name: Speech Difficulty
symptoms.description: Sudden difficulty speaking clearly, finding words, or understanding spoken language — a warning sign of possible stroke.

symptoms.name: Loss of Consciousness
symptoms.description: A temporary or prolonged loss of awareness and responsiveness. May be brief (fainting) or prolonged (emergency).

symptoms.name: Seizure
symptoms.description: Uncontrolled electrical activity in the brain causing involuntary movements, altered awareness, or stiffening. Emergency if prolonged (>5 minutes) or first-time.

symptoms.name: Chest Pain
symptoms.description: Pain, pressure, squeezing, or discomfort in the chest area. Can have many causes ranging from benign to life-threatening.

symptoms.name: Chest Pain Radiating to Arm, Jaw, or Shoulder
symptoms.description: Chest pain that spreads or radiates to the left arm, jaw, neck, or shoulder — a classic warning sign of a possible cardiac emergency.

symptoms.name: Chest Tightness
symptoms.description: A sensation of pressure, heaviness, or squeezing in the chest that may be related to cardiac, respiratory, or musculoskeletal causes.

symptoms.name: Palpitations
symptoms.description: An uncomfortable awareness of the heart beating — may feel like pounding, fluttering, skipping, or racing.

severity_descriptors.10: With chest pain/shortness of breath — emergency

symptoms.name: Irregular Heartbeat
symptoms.description: A sensation that the heart is beating unevenly, skipping beats, or beating too fast or too slow.

symptoms.name: Shortness of Breath with Chest Pain
symptoms.description: The combination of difficulty breathing and chest pain, which significantly raises concern for a cardiac or pulmonary emergency.

symptoms.name: Ankle or Leg Swelling
symptoms.description: Swelling of the ankles, feet, or lower legs due to fluid accumulation, which may indicate cardiac, kidney, or venous issues.

symptoms.name: Shortness of Breath
symptoms.description: An uncomfortable sensation of not getting enough air, ranging from mild exertional breathlessness to severe rest dyspnea.

symptoms.name: Cough
symptoms.description: A reflex action to clear the airways. May be dry or productive, acute or chronic.

severity_descriptors.10: With blood or severe difficulty — urgent

symptoms.name: Wheezing
symptoms.description: A high-pitched whistling sound when breathing, usually caused by narrowed or obstructed airways.

symptoms.name: Severe Difficulty Breathing
symptoms.description: Severe inability to breathe adequately, often with visible distress, use of accessory muscles, or inability to speak in full sentences.

symptoms.name: Coughing Up Blood
symptoms.description: Coughing up blood or blood-streaked mucus from the respiratory tract. Any amount warrants prompt evaluation.

symptoms.name: Rapid Breathing
symptoms.description: An abnormally fast breathing rate that may indicate respiratory distress, anxiety, metabolic disturbance, or other conditions.

symptoms.name: Nausea
symptoms.description: An unpleasant sensation of unease in the stomach, often accompanied by the urge to vomit.

severity_descriptors.10: With blood or severe abdominal pain — urgent

symptoms.name: Vomiting
symptoms.description: Forceful expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth. Repeated vomiting can lead to dehydration.

severity_descriptors.7-9: Persistent, unable to keep fluids down

symptoms.name: Abdominal Pain
symptoms.description: Pain or discomfort in the abdomen, ranging from mild cramping to severe, potentially indicating various conditions.

symptoms.name: Diarrhea
symptoms.description: Loose, watery, or frequent bowel movements. Can lead to dehydration, especially in the vulnerable.

severity_descriptors.7-9: Severe, bloody, unable to maintain fluids
severity_descriptors.10: With severe dehydration or blood — urgent

symptoms.name: Constipation
symptoms.description: Infrequent, difficult, or incomplete passage of hard stools.

severity_descriptors.10: With severe pain or vomiting — urgent

symptoms.name: Bloating
symptoms.description: A feeling of fullness or swelling in the abdomen, often accompanied by gas.

symptoms.name: Heartburn / Acid Reflux
symptoms.description: A burning sensation in the chest or throat caused by stomach acid flowing back into the oesophagus.

symptoms.name: Blood in Stool
symptoms.description: Visible red blood or dark tarry stools, indicating bleeding somewhere in the gastrointestinal tract.

symptoms.name: Difficulty Swallowing
symptoms.description: A sensation of food or liquid sticking in the throat or oesophagus, or pain when swallowing.

severity_descriptors.10: Complete obstruction or with allergic reaction — emergency

symptoms.name: Joint Pain
symptoms.description: Pain, aching, or soreness in one or more joints.

severity_descriptors.10: Joint locked or severely swollen — urgent

symptoms.name: Back Pain
symptoms.description: Pain in the upper, middle, or lower back. Very common and usually musculoskeletal, but rarely can indicate serious causes.

symptoms.name: Neck Pain
symptoms.description: Pain or stiffness in the neck area, ranging from muscle tension to conditions requiring urgent evaluation.

severity_descriptors.10: Severe neck stiffness with fever and rash — emergency (possible meningitis)

symptoms.name: General Muscle Weakness
symptoms.description: Reduced strength or stamina in the muscles throughout the body, not confined to one limb.

symptoms.name: Muscle Cramps
symptoms.description: Sudden, involuntary contractions of muscles causing pain, often in the legs.

severity_descriptors.10: With generalised cramping and weakness — urgent

symptoms.name: Joint Swelling
symptoms.description: Visible or palpable swelling of one or more joints, which may be accompanied by warmth, redness, or pain.

severity_descriptors.10: With severe pain and inability to move — urgent

symptoms.name: Stiffness
symptoms.description: Difficulty or discomfort when moving joints or muscles, especially after rest.

symptoms.name: Skin Rash
symptoms.description: An area of irritated or swollen skin that may be red, itchy, bumpy, or blistered.

severity_descriptors.10: With throat swelling or breathing difficulty — emergency

symptoms.name: Itching
symptoms.description: An irritating sensation that creates an urge to scratch, localised or generalised.

severity_descriptors.10: With rash and throat swelling — emergency

symptoms.name: Hives (Urticaria)
symptoms.description: Raised, itchy welts on the skin that can appear suddenly, potentially as part of an allergic reaction.

severity_descriptors.10: With throat swelling or breathing difficulty — emergency (anaphylaxis)

symptoms.name: Skin Discoloration
symptoms.description: Abnormal changes in skin color including yellowing (jaundice), pallor, or bluish tinge (cyanosis).

symptoms.name: Wound Not Healing
symptoms.description: A wound, sore, or ulcer that fails to heal within the expected timeframe.

severity_descriptors.10: With spreading redness and systemic symptoms — urgent

symptoms.name: Unusual Bruising
symptoms.description: Bruising that occurs easily or without known cause, possibly indicating a bleeding disorder or medication effect.

symptoms.name: Fever
symptoms.description: An elevated body temperature, typically above 38°C (100.4°F), usually indicating an immune response to infection or other causes.

severity_descriptors.10: Very high >40°C or with confusion — urgent

symptoms.name: Fatigue
symptoms.description: An overwhelming sense of tiredness, lack of energy, or exhaustion not relieved by rest.

severity_descriptors.10: With other severe symptoms — urgent evaluation

symptoms.name: Unexplained Weight Loss
symptoms.description: Significant weight loss (typically >5% of body weight) over weeks to months without dieting or increased activity.

severity_descriptors.10: With other alarming symptoms — urgent evaluation

symptoms.name: Night Sweats
symptoms.description: Excessive sweating during sleep that soaks clothing or bedding, beyond what would be explained by a warm environment.

severity_descriptors.10: With weight loss and fever — urgent evaluation

symptoms.name: Chills
symptoms.description: Shivering and feeling cold, often accompanying fever, infection, or other systemic conditions.

severity_descriptors.10: With high fever and altered consciousness — urgent

symptoms.name: Signs of Dehydration
symptoms.description: Insufficient fluid in the body. Signs include dry mouth, dark urine, decreased urination, dizziness, and confusion.

symptoms.name: Frequent Urination
symptoms.description: Needing to urinate more frequently than usual, day or night.

severity_descriptors.10: With blood in urine and severe pain — urgent

symptoms.name: Painful Urination
symptoms.description: Pain, burning, or discomfort during urination, often indicating a urinary tract infection or other condition.

severity_descriptors.10: With high fever and back pain — urgent (possible kidney infection)

symptoms.name: Blood in Urine
symptoms.description: Visible blood in the urine (pink, red, or brown discolouration) or detected on testing.

severity_descriptors.10: With severe pain and inability to urinate — urgent

symptoms.name: Reduced or No Urination
symptoms.description: Significantly decreased or absent urine output, which may indicate kidney problems or severe dehydration.

symptoms.name: Anxiety
symptoms.description: Persistent feelings of worry, fear, or unease that may be disproportionate to the situation.

severity_descriptors.10: With thoughts of self-harm — seek immediate help

symptoms.name: Depression Symptoms
symptoms.description: Persistent low mood, loss of interest in activities, fatigue, or other symptoms of depression lasting more than two weeks.

severity_descriptors.10: With thoughts of self-harm — seek immediate help

symptoms.name: Panic Attacks
symptoms.description: Sudden episodes of intense fear or discomfort that peak within minutes, with physical symptoms such as racing heart, sweating, or difficulty breathing.

severity_descriptors.10: With chest pain — rule out cardiac cause

symptoms.name: Severe Allergic Reaction / Anaphylaxis
symptoms.description: A severe, potentially life-threatening allergic reaction affecting multiple body systems. Signs include throat swelling, difficulty breathing, hives, low blood pressure, and collapse.

symptoms.name: Uncontrolled Bleeding
symptoms.description: Bleeding that cannot be controlled with direct pressure, or internal bleeding suspected.

symptoms.name: Signs of Shock
symptoms.description: A life-threatening condition where the body cannot supply enough blood to vital organs. Signs include pale clammy skin, rapid weak pulse, confusion, and loss of consciousness.

symptoms.name: Signs of Stroke (FAST)
symptoms.description: Warning signs of stroke using the FAST acronym: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call emergency services.

symptoms.name: Excessive Sweating
symptoms.description: Abnormal or excessive sweating, particularly cold sweats, which may accompany cardiac events, infections, or anxiety.

severity_descriptors.10: With chest pain or collapse — emergency

symptoms.name: Loss of Appetite
symptoms.description: Reduced desire to eat, which can accompany many conditions including infections, mental health conditions, and chronic disease.

severity_descriptors.10: With significant weight loss — urgent evaluation

symptoms.name: Sore Throat
symptoms.description: Pain, scratchiness, or irritation of the throat, often worsening when swallowing.

severity_descriptors.10: With throat swelling or stridor — emergency

symptoms.name: Runny Nose
symptoms.description: Excess nasal mucus discharge, commonly associated with colds, allergies, or sinusitis.

symptoms.name: Ear Pain
symptoms.description: Pain in one or both ears, which may be caused by infection, injury, or referred pain from nearby structures.

severity_descriptors.10: With high fever and altered hearing — seek evaluation

symptoms.name: Eye Pain
symptoms.description: Pain in or around one or both eyes, which may accompany redness, swelling, or vision changes.

symptoms.name: Sudden Loss of Vision
symptoms.description: Sudden, complete or partial loss of vision in one or both eyes, which is a medical emergency.

symptoms.name: Urinary Incontinence
symptoms.description: Involuntary leakage of urine.

severity_descriptors.10: With sudden onset and back pain — urgent (cauda equina)

symptoms.name: Flank Pain
symptoms.description: Pain in the side of the torso between the lower ribs and hip, often associated with kidney conditions.

symptoms.name: Mouth Ulcers
symptoms.description: Painful sores inside the mouth on the cheeks, tongue, or gums.

symptoms.name: Hair Loss
symptoms.description: Loss of hair from the scalp or body, which may be patchy or diffuse.

symptoms.name: Tremors
symptoms.description: Involuntary, rhythmic muscle contractions causing shaking movements in one or more body parts.

severity_descriptors.10: Sudden severe tremor with other symptoms — urgent

symptoms.name: Memory Problems
symptoms.description: Difficulty remembering recent events, following instructions, or other memory-related concerns.

severity_descriptors.10: Sudden severe memory loss — urgent evaluation

symptoms.name: Increased Thirst
symptoms.description: Feeling unusually thirsty despite adequate fluid intake, which can be associated with diabetes, dehydration, or other conditions.

symptoms.name: Swollen Lymph Nodes
symptoms.description: Enlarged lymph nodes, often felt as lumps in the neck, armpits, or groin, usually indicating immune system activity.

severity_descriptors.10: With fever and night sweats — seek evaluation

symptoms.name: Signs of High Blood Sugar
symptoms.description: Signs that blood sugar may be elevated, including increased thirst, frequent urination, blurred vision, and fatigue.

symptoms.name: Signs of Low Blood Sugar
symptoms.description: Signs that blood sugar may be low, including shakiness, sweating, confusion, and in severe cases, loss of consciousness.

symptoms.name: Pregnancy-Related Concerns
symptoms.description: Symptoms of concern during pregnancy such as severe abdominal pain, heavy bleeding, reduced fetal movement, or severe headache.

severity_descriptors.10: Severe bleeding or no fetal movement — emergency
